headline: CSU Pueblo pull clear at the top of the table
dek: CSU Pueblo's win at Colorado Christian was their twelfth of the season, beside two draws and no defeats. They have conceded ten goals in that time; Regis, the nearest side to them in the table, have conceded fewer.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 25; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: CSU Pueblo are the last unbeaten side in the conference after UCCS lost at Colorado Mesa.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Regis have conceded nine goals this season, across eight wins, three draws and three defeats.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and twelve defeats, the latest at home to Fort Lewis.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: CSU Pueblo's Nick Cenek has eleven goals and four assists this season, from 48 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 61 saves this season and conceded 14 goals.

last_match.line: Colorado Christian have not won since beating Colorado School of Mines; CSU Pueblo have won every conference match since drawing with Regis.

next_match.line: Colorado School of Mines are still looking for a first win; CSU Pueblo are still looking for a first defeat.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
